t: DEWALT DCD778P2T-SFGB 18V XR combi drill delivers reliable brushless performance for drilling, hammer drilling and controlled screwdriving. A 13mm metal keyless chuck, all-metal gearing and 15 torque settings support consistent work across timber, metal and masonry, delivering up to 65Nm torque. The compact body with rubber overmould grip offers comfortable handling, while the LED light improves visibility in tight or low-light areas. Suitable for consistent screwdriving into a variety of materials with different screw sizes. Supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah XR batteries, charger and TSTAK kit box for organised storage.
